audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 6, First item and 2+ items were all labelled 'Skill' while their own whys say the opposite — whys[4] 'Level 6 flips to you', whys[5] 'First item favours you', whys[6] 'At 2+ items you win the 1v1'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart gives Mundo all three of those stages, and the 53.62% Emerald+ win rate comes entirely from them; Teemo owns Levels 1 through 5.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-5 Teemo, Level 6 / First item / 2+ items Dr. Mundo. Submitted as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was described only as 'R lets you all-in through blind' without saying what the ultimate actually does, and the 2+ item stage was rated 5/10 — lower than the two stages before it, on a chart that claims you keep improving.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage instantly heals a percent of missing health, then regenerates over a long duration, on a flat 120s. That is what survives a poison-and-blind attrition pattern, and it only compounds with HP items.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now names the mechanic; the 2+ item rating rises to 7/10 in line with the other post-item stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Blinding Dart as if it shuts your whole kit down. It blinds basic attacks only: Infected Bonesaw and Heart Zapper's aura keep dealing full damage through it. Range was never given either — your Bonesaw reaches 975 against his 680 dart, so you can poke from outside it all lane.
audit.why: Riot text: Blinding Dart blinds the target unit (680 range, 7s, 70-90 mana). Mundo Q 975 range, W is a persistent aura with a recast burst at 325 range. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion from Teemo's side: he must spend the blind on autos and the Blunt Force Trauma reset wind-up, not on the Heart Zapper cast.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early and whys[2] now state that the blind does not touch Bonesaw or Zapper, and give the 975-vs-680 range gap as the poke plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told you to buy tenacity so Blinding Dart falls off. Tenacity does not shorten a blind, and Grievous Wounds does nothing against Teemo either — he has no healing in his kit.
audit.why: Teemo's kit contains no heal and no immobilising effect. Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage that scales with attack speed, so magic resist is the buy, not armour and not tenacity.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now points at MR and names Toxic Shot as attack-speed-scaling on-hit damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' is real — sequencingCues was 0.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank and costs 70/75/80/85/90 mana, so it is both trackable and mana-limited early.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now gives the 7s flat cooldown and the mana cost as the bait-then-step trigger.

edits.after: Level 1 is his — Toxic Shot poison chips you and Blinding Dart is 7s flat.

edits.after: Level 3 is his: the blind stops autos, though not Bonesaw or Zapper.

edits.before: Teemo owns the early lane: his Q Blinding Dart shuts off your autos so your Q slow can't be followed up, his auto-attack poison from Toxic Shot chips your bar constantly, and his movement-speed passive kites you out of Heart Zapper range — expect to eat poke and give up CS.
edits.after: Teemo owns the early lane: Blinding Dart turns off your autos and his Toxic Shot poison chips your bar constantly while his speed passive kites you out of Heart Zapper's 325 range. The blind does not touch Infected Bonesaw or Zapper's aura — poke from 975, outside his 680 dart, and give up the CS.

edits.before: Levels 1-4 belong to Teemo: Q Blinding Dart turns off your autos, Toxic Shot poison chips you every trade, and his passive speed kites you out of Heart Zapper range, so you soak poke and farm patiently.
edits.after: Levels 1-4 belong to Teemo: Blinding Dart turns off your autos, Toxic Shot chips you every trade, and his speed passive kites you out of Heart Zapper's 325 range. Poke from 975 — outside his 680 dart — and farm patiently.
